say:3:1210328001:1.text: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.
say:3:1210328001:1.source_cn: 咦，这里……这是我们来钓冥湾美人的地方呀！
say:3:1210328001:1.male: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.
say:3:1210328001:1.female: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.

say:4:1210328002:1.text: That's right. This is where the Whispers get their lumber.
say:4:1210328002:1.source_cn: 没错，这是血薇帮砍树取木材的地方。

say:5:1210328003:1.text: This place is dangerous! If you knew that the Whispers were stationed nearby, why did you tell us to come here and fish?
say:5:1210328003:1.source_cn: 但是，但是，这里很危险！明明血薇帮就在这附近驻扎，你还...

say:6:1210328004:1.text: I had no choice. If you wanted to find a damedangler at Blackwood Loch, you either had to go from the beach where I found you or go from Rustport's northwest gate.
say:6:1210328004:1.source_cn: 我也没辙！去黑木湖钓冥湾美人，要么从我捞到你们的沙滩走...

say:7:1210328005:1.text: No matter which route you take, there'll be Whispers guarding the place. At least this one had fewer guards. Don't blame me for getting caught last time.
say:7:1210328005:1.source_cn: 不管哪边，都有血薇帮把守着。上面这条路防守还稀疏点，怎...

choice_prompt:8:1210328005.text: No matter which route you take, there'll be Whispers guarding the place. At least this one had fewer guards. Don't blame me for getting caught last time.
choice_prompt:8:1210328005.source_cn: 不管哪边，都有血薇帮把守着。上面这条路防守还稀疏点，怎么能怪我指错了路？

say:9:1210328007:1.text: Alright, we can talk about that later.

say:11:1210328008:1.text: Why do the Whispers need so much wood?
say:11:1210328008:1.source_cn: 他们……血薇帮砍这么多木头干什么？

say:12:1210328009:1.text: I hear it's to build a ship big enough to take on the Immortal from the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:12:1210328009:1.source_cn: 听说是为了造一艘又大又好，能正面迎击死潮舰队不死号的大船。

say:13:1210328010:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet is an infamous group of Graveborn pirates. The Immortal is their flagship, a terrifying ship as black as the deepest abyss.
say:13:1210328010:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队嘛，就是我之前提起过的那帮亡灵海盗。不死号是死...

say:14:1210328011:1.text: The Whispers are also forcing people to dig up rocks. Do ships need rocks?
say:14:1210328011:1.source_cn: 但是，血薇帮好像还在强迫劳工挖石头。造船也需要石头……？

say:15:1210328012:1.text: Rocks? Maybe they want to put catapults on the ship.
say:15:1210328012:1.source_cn: 压舱石？也没准他们要在船上装投石车。

choice_prompt:16:1210328012.text: Rocks? Maybe they want to put catapults on the ship.
choice_prompt:16:1210328012.source_cn: 压舱石？也没准他们要在船上装投石车。

say:17:1210328013:1.text: Let's not worry about what the Whispers are up to for now. Where are we going?
say:17:1210328013:1.source_cn: 先别管血薇帮了，我们现在要去哪里呢？

say:18:1210328014:1.text: They think we're spies for the Water Wights. We can't go back to Rustport.
say:18:1210328014:1.source_cn: 血薇帮把我们当成水鬼的间谍，锈锚港肯定是回不去了，那里...

choice_prompt:19:1210328014.text: They think we're spies for the Water Wights. We can't go back to Rustport.
choice_prompt:19:1210328014.source_cn: 血薇帮把我们当成水鬼的间谍，锈锚港肯定是回不去了，那里是他们的地盘。

say:20:1210328015:1.text: I'm glad you trust me. I do know a way to get you all out of here, but it passes by the Whispers' shipyard. What do you think?
say:20:1210328015:1.source_cn: 真高兴你们这么信任我。当然，我的确知道一条路可以送你们...

say:21:1210328016:1.text: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!
say:21:1210328016:1.source_cn: 有主人在，满满和漫漫什么都不怕！
say:21:1210328016:1.male: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!
say:21:1210328016:1.female: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!

say:22:1210328017:1.text: Not bad, little guy! You're braver than you look.
say:22:1210328017:1.source_cn: 不错嘛，小家伙，挺有勇气！

say:23:1210328018:1.text: Alright, passengers! It's time to leave this place.
say:23:1210328018:1.source_cn: 辛巴达荣幸之至，走吧，我的船客们！

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 靠我们的万事通先生了

say:25:1210328006:1.text: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.
say:25:1210328006:1.source_cn: 要是能用金子做谢礼就更好了，<male>兄弟</mal...
say:25:1210328006:1.male: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.
say:25:1210328006:1.female: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.

choice:8:1:2.text: Once again, thanks for helping us.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 再次向你表示诚挚的谢意
choice:8:1:2.male: Once again, thanks for helping us.
choice:8:1:2.female: Once again, thanks for helping us.

say:0:1210329001:0.text: Go here. There's a hidden door.
say:0:1210329001:0.source_cn: 走这里，有个隐藏的树门。

say:0:1210330001:0.text: Be careful. Look at the tracks on the ground. There are dangerous animals around.
say:0:1210330001:0.source_cn: 小心，看地上的脚印，这里有比人更危险的野兽出没。

say:3:1210332001:1.text: After crossing the bridge in front, if you continue west, you'll reach the Whispers' shipyard.
say:3:1210332001:1.source_cn: 过了前面的小木桥，继续往西，就是血薇帮的造船厂了。

say:7:1210332005:1.text: We can't let our guard down now. It's better to leave as soon as possible.
say:7:1210332005:1.source_cn: 现在还不能放松警惕，还是早点离开这里比较好。

say:8:1210332006:1.text: Hey, lighten up. We're almost at the shipyard. This is where the adventure really begins.
say:8:1210332006:1.source_cn: 打起精神各位，快到造船厂了。真正的冒险，现在才开始呢。

say:10:1210332004:1.text: Uh... Not really. Either you escape through the waterway south of the shipyard or go back the other way. I think this path is safer.
say:10:1210332004:1.source_cn: 真没有，要么从造船厂南边的水路溜走，要么原路返回。要我...

say:0:1210401001:0.text: Wow... it's so high. This is the first time Chippy has seen such a high wall.
say:0:1210401001:0.source_cn: 哇……好高，满满第一次看到这么高的墙。

say:1:1210401002:0.text: This wall protects the Whispers' shipyard. To prevent attacks, they deliberately built the wall ridiculously high.
say:1:1210401002:0.source_cn: 这是血薇帮造船厂的墙。为了防止水鬼帮偷袭，他们故意把墙...

say:2:1210401003:0.text: Don't go upstairs. That's the Whispers' territory.
say:2:1210401003:0.source_cn: 别往楼梯上走，那是血薇帮的地盘。

say:0:1210405001:0.text: Hey, come up! Take the stairs in front!
say:0:1210405001:0.source_cn: 嘿，上来，上来！走旁边的楼梯！

say:1:1210406001:0.text: I saw it! You stopped my shots with magic!
say:1:1210406001:0.source_cn: 我都看见了！你挡下了我的炮弹，用魔法！！！
say:1:1210406001:0.male: I saw it! You stopped my shots with magic!
say:1:1210406001:0.female: I saw it! You stopped my shots with magic!

say:2:1210406002:0.text: Your barrier looked as flimsy as a butterfly's wing, but it actually blocked my cannonballs! Incredible!
say:2:1210406002:0.source_cn: 屏障比蝉翼还脆弱，却能挡下我的呼金炮！了不起！

say:3:1210406003:0.text: Dura above, the goddess must've heard my prayers and sent a mage to help me with designs!

say:10:1210406008:1.text: Okay, I'll be honest. I am somewhat connected to the Carmine Whispers. Hugin is a talented craftsman who can make all sorts of interesting things. I just introduced him to the Whispers.
say:10:1210406008:1.source_cn: 好吧，我摊牌，其实……我和血薇帮有点交情。呼金是个不错...

say:11:1210406009:1.text: Hugin's making a special cannon to deal with the Dead Tide Fleet. He's in need of a mage, and it just so happens that you're in need of a ship. I was thinking if you could do him a favor, he could do you a favor.
say:11:1210406009:1.source_cn: 呼金研究对付死潮舰队的火炮，缺个魔法师，正好你们缺船。...
say:11:1210406009:1.male: Hugin's making a special cannon to deal with the Dead Tide Fleet. He's in need of a mage, and it just so happens that you're in need of a ship. I was thinking if you could do him a favor, he could do you a favor.

say:13:1210406010:1.text: But he opened fire as soon as he saw us!
say:13:1210406010:1.source_cn: 但这家伙一看见我们就开炮！

say:14:1210406011:1.text: Yes, well, that couldn't be helped. The Water Wights have been restless lately, and we've been on high alert for a while.
say:14:1210406011:1.source_cn: 没办法，最近水鬼帮的不老实，我们也绷着一根弦，看到只松...

say:15:1210406012:1.text: Look, let's be friends. If you want a ship, I can help. I just need your help with enchantments.
say:15:1210406012:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，不打不相识，你要船，好说好说！只要你们帮我附魔！
say:15:1210406012:1.male: Look, let's be friends. If you want a ship, I can help. I just need your help with enchantments.
say:15:1210406012:1.female: Look, let's be friends. If you want a ship, I can help. I just need your help with enchantments.

say:18:1210406013:1.text: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!
say:18:1210406013:1.male: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!
say:18:1210406013:1.female: You didn't even apologize to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and you're already asking for something? How rude!

say:19:1210406014:1.text: Apologize to the magister? Well, I'm sorry then! You can shoot me if that'll make you feel better. I'm serious. Whistler, Hardhead, Fireside, and Shorty... They all agree with me.
say:19:1210406014:1.source_cn: 道歉？我有诚意！你可以朝我开一炮消气。我是说真的，尖哨...

say:21:1210406016:1.text: They are my best friends, my assistants, and my inspiration! Look, they're saying hello to you!
say:21:1210406016:1.source_cn: 他们是我的挚友，最好的助手，给力的观众，还有最棒的灵感...

say:22:1210406017:1.text: Umm... you mean that your prosthetic, hammer, furnace, and forge... have names...
say:22:1210406017:1.source_cn: 呃……你是说，你的金属假肢，大铁锤，烧火炉，锻造台叫尖...

say:23:1210406018:1.text: That's right! And you remembered all of them! Look, they're so happy.
say:23:1210406018:1.source_cn: 火墙，矮地。没错！太棒了，你居然记住他们的名字了，瞧，...

say:24:1210406019:1.text: Hugin seems to be able to see the souls of things... if that's even possible.
say:24:1210406019:1.source_cn: 呼金……他仿佛能看到这些东西的灵魂——如果它们有的话。

say:27:1210406020:1.text: You'll get used to it. When I first met Hugin, he surprised me too. I learned later that he's just a crazy inventor. He gets the most riled up when he's talking about his creations.
say:27:1210406020:1.source_cn: 习惯就好，我刚认识呼金的时候，也被他吓了一跳。后来才知...

say:28:1210406021:1.source_cn: 请帮小金箭附魔吧！有你的魔法，加上我的技术，我们肯定攻...

say:29:1210406022:1.text: Wait... Don't tell me Flintblaster is the name of your cannon.

say:30:1210406023:1.source_cn: 喏，刚才那一炮，就是小金箭发射的，我把他的弹道改良了三...

say:40:1210406029:1.source_cn: 别忘了，我们还被血薇帮当成水鬼关了起来，现在他们说不定...

say:41:1210406030:1.source_cn: 对，辛巴达，你说能送我们离开？船呢？

say:45:1210406032:1.text: Well, I do have ships if you want them. However, if we don't deal with the Dead Tide Fleet and that kraken, you'll never be able to leave.
say:45:1210406032:1.source_cn: 咳咳，要船我有。但不解决死潮舰队和那只海怪，你们永远也...

say:48:1210406033:1.source_cn: 不答应帮你附魔，就没法离开这里吗？嗯……总感觉被威胁了。

say:59:1210406004:0.text: Of course! It's not every day I meet a mage, I can't pass this opportunity up.
say:59:1210406004:0.male: Of course! It's not every day I meet a mage, I can't pass this opportunity up.
say:59:1210406004:0.female: Of course! It's not every day I meet a mage, I can't pass this opportunity up.

choice:4:1:2.text: You want to take advantage of me?
choice:4:1:2.male: You want to take advantage of me?
choice:4:1:2.female: You want to take advantage of me?

say:4:1210407001:1.text: Magister, what do you think about my Flintblaster? What type of supplies do you need for enchantments? Please tell me. My sweet Flintblaster deserves only the best of the best!
say:4:1210407001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，小金箭检查结果怎么样，附魔仪式需要准备什么...

say:6:1210407003:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，铁头说，“你不是个品德很坏的小伙子，如果你的嘴...

say:7:1210407004:1.text: Please tell Hardhead that he's a hammer, and it's better if he talks less.
say:7:1210407004:1.source_cn: 请转告铁头，作为一个锤子，它还是话少点比较好。

say:9:1210407005:1.text: Okay, you two, stop arguing. Let's hear what the magister has to say.
say:9:1210407005:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，你们俩别斗嘴了，听听看主人要说什么吧！
say:9:1210407005:1.male: Okay, you two, stop arguing. Let's hear what the magister has to say.
say:9:1210407005:1.female: Okay, you two, stop arguing. Let's hear what the magister has to say.

choice_prompt:10:1210407005.female: Okay, you two, stop arguing. Let's hear what the magister has to say.

say:12:1210407006:0.text: Yes, I think we need a few flarowlstones, but we're on an island... If we collect some <style="highlight">oceanwood</style> and <style="highlight">sealom bones</style>, they could be used as replacements.
say:12:1210407006:0.source_cn: 唔，应该是需要火枭石，但是这里是海岛……要是能采到<s...

say:13:1210407007:1.text: There should be some nearby. We'll have someone go gather some.
say:13:1210407007:1.source_cn: 附近有！我这就让人去采！

say:14:1210407008:1.text: I guess I could help out.

choice_prompt:15:1210407008.text: I guess I could help out.

say:16:1210407009:1.text: Alright, we'll leave it up to you then.

say:17:1210407010:1.text: Now that I think about it, I don't know if I can be much help looking for magical things. I'll stay here and keep Hugin company. Let us know if you need help with anything.
say:17:1210407010:1.source_cn: 既然帮不上忙，那我就留在这和呼金叙叙旧。辛苦你们啦。

choice:15:0:1.text: Yes, me too. I want some fresh air.
choice:15:0:1.male: Yes, me too. I want some fresh air.
choice:15:0:1.female: Yes, me too. I want some fresh air.

say:0:1210407501:0.source_cn: 你还是老样子，不留情面，哈哈！

say:1:1210407502:0.text: When are you going to find a real job...?
say:1:1210407502:0.source_cn: 你这小伙子……找个正经工作不好吗？

say:0:1210408001:0.text: Hmm... oceanwood and sealom bones are generally found near the water.
say:0:1210408001:0.source_cn: 唔……海孤木和海沙骨一般分布在有水域的地方。

say:1:1210408002:0.text: Let's look along the road outside the workshop.
say:1:1210408002:0.source_cn: 我们在工坊外沿路找找吧！

say:0:1210410001:0.text: Oceanwood and sealom bones are both mediums used for enchantment.
say:0:1210410001:0.source_cn: 海孤木和海沙骨，都是注能魔法的媒介。

say:2:1210410003:0.text: Of course! That's because I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reliable assistant.
say:2:1210410003:0.male: Of course! That's because I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reliable assistant.
say:2:1210410003:0.female: Of course! That's because I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reliable assistant.

say:0:1210411001:0.text: Next, let's go find some sealom bones.
say:0:1210411001:0.source_cn: 接下来去采海沙骨，从这个山坡下去就是海滩。

say:0:1210412001:0.text: Wow... the sea breeze is so refreshing.
say:0:1210412001:0.source_cn: 哇……湿润的泥土和海风，好清爽。

say:1:1210412002:0.text: If our boat hadn't capsized, we would still be enjoying the sea breeze out over the water...
say:1:1210412002:0.source_cn: 如果船没翻，我们现在也在悠闲地吹着海风呢……

say:0:1210414001:0.source_cn: 满满好像听到海浪的声音了。

say:1:1210414002:0.text: I hear it too. I hear seagulls as well.
say:1:1210414002:0.source_cn: 漫漫也听到了，还有海鸥的叫声。

say:2:1210415001:1.text: Everything's been collected, but Chippy doesn't want to go back.
say:2:1210415001:1.source_cn: 两种材料都采齐了，但满满却有点不想回去了呢！

say:3:1210415002:1.text: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?
say:3:1210415002:1.source_cn: 主人待会附魔，又要消耗很多魔力吧？
say:3:1210415002:1.male: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?
say:3:1210415002:1.female: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?

say:4:1210415003:1.text: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...
say:4:1210415003:1.male: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...

choice_prompt:5:1210415003.male: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...
choice_prompt:5:1210415003.female: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think she's worried about something else right now...

say:6:1210415004:1.text: Yes, he's a crafty one. He told us he would help us sail away, but actually, he just took us to meet Hugin.
say:6:1210415004:1.source_cn: 他太狡猾了，明明说要送我们走，但其实是带我们去见呼金！

say:7:1210415005:1.text: He's also very mysterious. He always seems to appear when we need him.
say:7:1210415005:1.source_cn: 而且他很神秘，总是能在我们需要的时候出现。

say:8:1210415006:1.text: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.
say:8:1210415006:1.source_cn: 决定了，满满接下来要好好观察辛巴达！不能让他伤害主人！
say:8:1210415006:1.male: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.
say:8:1210415006:1.female: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.

say:9:1210415007:1.text: Don't forget. The Whispers still think we're Water Wights. We need to have Hugin clear that up for us.
say:9:1210415007:1.source_cn: 别忘了，我们还顶着水鬼帮的名头，待会一定要让呼金给我们...

say:10:1210415008:1.text: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.
say:10:1210415008:1.source_cn: 没错，满满也受够了。待会主人给我们信号，就看我和漫漫发挥吧！
say:10:1210415008:1.male: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.
say:10:1210415008:1.female: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.

say:11:1210415009:1.text: Alright, let's go back to Hugin.

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 辛巴达到底在盘算什么？

choice:5:1:2.text: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 辛巴达嘴里有过实话吗？
choice:5:1:2.male: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?
choice:5:1:2.female: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?

say:1:1210417001:0.text: You got the oceanwood and the sealom bones, right? Should we get started?
say:1:1210417001:0.source_cn: 您应该也采集好了海孤木和海沙骨吧？那咱们这就开始？
say:1:1210417001:0.male: You got the oceanwood and the sealom bones, right? Should we get started?
say:1:1210417001:0.female: You got the oceanwood and the sealom bones, right? Should we get started?

say:2:1210417002:1.text: Okay, everyone, step back. Let's get out of the magister's way.
say:2:1210417002:1.source_cn: 咳！所有人，往后退一步，别耽误魔法师大人发挥。
say:2:1210417002:1.male: Okay, everyone, step back. Let's get out of the magister's way.
say:2:1210417002:1.female: Okay, everyone, step back. Let's get out of the magister's way.

choice_prompt:3:1210417002.male: Okay, everyone, step back. Let's get out of the magister's way.
choice_prompt:3:1210417002.female: Okay, everyone, step back. Let's get out of the magister's way.

say:4:1210417003:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么了！出什么岔子了吗？

say:6:1210417004:0.text: Master Hugin, I don't know if you know, but we actually had to escape from Darkstone Cave. The Whispers thought we were Water Wights and treated us like prisoners.
say:6:1210417004:0.source_cn: 咳咳……呼金先生，不知道你知不知道，其实我们是从血薇帮...

say:8:1210417005:1.text: Ever since arriving in Rustport, we've been tricked, chased, and lied to. Chippy almost drowned...
say:8:1210417005:1.source_cn: 自从来到锈锚港，又是落水，又是被追杀，满满已经精疲力尽了……

say:9:1210417006:1.text: Even if the enchantment works and the Whispers defeat the Dead Tide Fleet, we would still be captives... Will the Whispers let us go?
say:9:1210417006:1.source_cn: 就算附魔成功，血薇帮用秘密武器成功打败死潮舰队，我们也...

say:10:1210417007:1.text: Master Hugin is such a nice person, and Hardhead and the others are so friendly. Chippy thinks they'll help us if we ask them to.
say:10:1210417007:1.source_cn: 呼金先生人这么大方，铁头他们又如此热情，怎么可能让他的...

say:11:1210417008:1.text: If someone could confirm we're not Water Wights and prove our innocence...
say:11:1210417008:1.source_cn: 唉……如果有人能帮我们洗刷水鬼的污名，证明我们是无辜的……

say:12:1210417009:1.text: Even Hardhead can see that you're all good people!
say:12:1210417009:1.source_cn: 啊？无辜还需要证明吗？铁头都看得出来你们是善良正直的人！

say:15:1210417011:0.text: I can't watch this any longer. Hugin won't understand if you beat around the bush. Just tell him straight.
say:15:1210417011:0.source_cn: 哈！我看不下去了。你们可以说明白些，绕弯子的话呼金听不懂的。

say:16:1210417012:0.text: Master Hugin, of course we'll help you with your enchantments. But could you tell the Whispers to stop chasing us and calling us Water Wights?
say:16:1210417012:0.source_cn: 好吧，呼金先生，要想我们帮你附魔，可以。前提是你帮我们...

say:17:1210417013:0.text: Also, after that, we would like a ship to take us to Cedartown.
say:17:1210417013:0.source_cn: 对，事成之后，还要给我们船，送我们去雪松镇。

say:19:1210417014:0.text: Oh yes, that's fine! I can do that. I was worried that the enchantment wouldn't work. I was about to tear my hair out!
say:19:1210417014:0.source_cn: 太好了！原来是这事。我还担心附魔成不了，寒毛都竖起来了！

say:20:1210417015:0.text: Don't worry. I'll take care of it.
say:20:1210417015:0.source_cn: 别担心，这件事就包在我身上！小意思！

say:21:1210417016:0.text: Even if you threw old Tesio into the sea, I'll make sure no one bothers you.
say:21:1210417016:0.source_cn: 别说你们是俘虏，就算你们把泰西欧丢进海里——也没人能找...

choice_prompt:22:1210417016.text: Even if you threw old Tesio into the sea, I'll make sure no one bothers you.
choice_prompt:22:1210417016.source_cn: 别说你们是俘虏，就算你们把泰西欧丢进海里——也没人能找你们麻烦！

say:23:1210417017:0.text: Okay, let's get started! I can't wait!
say:23:1210417017:0.source_cn: 开始吧！我已经迫不及待了！

choice:3:1:2.text: There's something we need help with.
choice:3:1:2.male: There's something we need help with.
choice:3:1:2.female: There's something we need help with.

say:0:1210418001:0.text: Amazing! You upgraded my Flintblaster, and now it's a Flintbomber!
say:0:1210418001:0.source_cn: 哇呼！小金箭升级成超级金箭了！

say:1:1210418002:0.text: I need to test and record the performance of the Flintbomber immediately!
say:1:1210418002:0.source_cn: 帮我招待魔法师大人，我需要立马测试记录超级金箭的表现！
say:1:1210418002:0.male: I need to test and record the performance of the Flintbomber immediately!
say:1:1210418002:0.female: I need to test and record the performance of the Flintbomber immediately!

say:0:1210419001:0.text: The workshop is open now. I'll take you there to have a look.
say:0:1210419001:0.source_cn: 这座工坊现在对你敞开了，要去那边看看吗？

say:3:1210423001:1.text: Stop fighting, my friends! This is all a misunderstanding!
say:3:1210423001:1.source_cn: 哦豁，我的两位恩人，别打啦！都是误会！

say:4:1210423002:1.text: They're Water Wights. They should not be here.
say:4:1210423002:1.source_cn: 他们是水鬼，你不能让他们进来。尤其是这里。

say:5:1210423003:1.text: All I know is that he's a mage!
say:5:1210423003:1.male: All I know is that he's a mage!
say:5:1210423003:1.female: All I know is that she's a mage!

say:6:1210423004:1.text: So what if he's a mage? They could also be enemies.
say:6:1210423004:1.source_cn: 魔法师又怎样，他们也可能是水鬼帮的人。
say:6:1210423004:1.male: So what if he's a mage? They could also be enemies.
say:6:1210423004:1.female: So what if she's a mage? They could also be enemies.

say:7:1210423005:1.text: They just upgraded my Flintblaster. With one shot, it'll shake the Graveborns to their very core.
say:7:1210423005:1.source_cn: 不会有错的。他们刚才帮我升级了小金箭，它现在能一发就让...

say:8:1210423006:1.text: If they were Water Wights, they would've blown up the base. I have gunpowder everywhere.
say:8:1210423006:1.source_cn: 要是他们是水鬼帮的，别说给小金箭附魔了，应该一发火药让...

say:10:1210423008:1.text: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.
say:10:1210423008:1.source_cn: 来，魔法师大人，这是我们血薇帮的大当家——索尼娅。
say:10:1210423008:1.male: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.
say:10:1210423008:1.female: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.

choice_prompt:11:1210423008.text: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.
choice_prompt:11:1210423008.source_cn: 来，魔法师大人，这是我们血薇帮的大当家——索尼娅。
choice_prompt:11:1210423008.male: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.
choice_prompt:11:1210423008.female: Come, Magister. This is Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.

say:12:1210423010:1.text: Okay, Magister. If you're not a Water Wight, then you should've been a guest of honor.
say:12:1210423010:1.source_cn: 魔法师，如果你不是水鬼，你应该是我血薇帮的座上宾。
say:12:1210423010:1.male: Okay, Magister. If you're not a Water Wight, then you should've been a guest of honor.
say:12:1210423010:1.female: Okay, Magister. If you're not a Water Wight, then you should've been a guest of honor.

say:13:1210423011:0.text: Well, he's not. So he can still be a guest of honor, right?
say:13:1210423011:0.male: Well, he's not. So he can still be a guest of honor, right?
say:13:1210423011:0.female: Well, she's not. So she can still be a guest of honor, right?

narration:24:1210423017:1.text: You hear sounds of fighting nearby. Sonja recognizes the voices of the Water Wights and immediately leads her people over.

choice:11:1:2.text: I just want to leave Rustport.
choice:11:1:2.male: I just want to leave Rustport.
choice:11:1:2.female: I just want to leave Rustport.

say:5:1210426002:1.text: Who is that woman with the grappling hook?! She was tough...
say:5:1210426002:1.source_cn: 那个用钩索的女人是谁？！她好厉害！

say:6:1210426003:1.text: And she called Sonja her sister...
say:6:1210426003:1.source_cn: 而且她竟然叫血薇帮的老大……姐姐？

say:7:1210426004:1.text: Nara's my sister, but she died in a shipwreck long ago.
say:7:1210426004:1.source_cn: 奈拉是我的妹妹，但她很久之前就死在了一场海难里。

say:9:1210426005:1.text: I don't know how Nara became a Graveborn and why she's the leader of the Water Wights, but I'll find out and give everyone an explanation.
say:9:1210426005:1.source_cn: 我也不知道为什么奈拉会变成亡灵，还成了水鬼帮的头。我会...

say:12:1210426006:1.text: Those dirty seadogs made a mess here! Oh, my darlings! Look at you all!
say:12:1210426006:1.source_cn: 可恨的水鬼，把这里搅得一团糟！我的宝贝噢！你们太惨了！

say:15:1210426007:1.text: Boss, the cannon blueprints are missing.
say:15:1210426007:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，大炮设计图不见了！

say:16:1210426008:1.text: We have to go after them. Those blueprints are essential.
say:16:1210426008:1.source_cn: 追！一定要把设计图带回来！

say:17:1210426009:1.text: Lucca, take your men and go after them. Hugin and I will stay here in case they attack again.
say:17:1210426009:1.source_cn: 卢卡，你带人走水路追，我和呼金留下，以防水鬼再次突袭。

say:18:1210426010:1.text: Leave it to me. I'll bring back the blueprints and the heads of those who attacked us.
say:18:1210426010:1.source_cn: 交给我吧，我一定把设计图和那帮水鬼的脑袋带回来。

say:21:1210426011:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.
say:21:1210426011:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.
say:21:1210426011:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.

choice_prompt:22:1210426011.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.
choice_prompt:22:1210426011.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style> 魔法师大人，你能跟着卢卡去吗？设计图要是被水鬼抢走，那我们可就麻烦了！
choice_prompt:22:1210426011.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.
choice_prompt:22:1210426011.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you go with Lucca? If the Wights escape with those blueprints, then we're all in trouble.

say:25:1210426012:1.text: Let me make it clear. We're helping you, so you're not allowed to accuse us of being Water Wights anymore.
say:25:1210426012:1.source_cn: 事先说好喔，我们要是帮你们，可不许再冤枉我们是水鬼了！

say:26:1210426016:0.text: If the Water Wights use the blueprints and recreate my cannons, then Rustport will stay sealed forever.
say:26:1210426016:0.source_cn: 但如果水鬼得到了设计图，拿大炮来对付我们，这锈锚港解封...

say:27:1210426017:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us for the sake of Hardhead, Shorty, and Fireside. Also, I'll have Sonja apologize to you.
say:27:1210426017:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us for the sake of Hardhead, Shorty, and Fireside. Also, I'll have Sonja apologize to you.
say:27:1210426017:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us for the sake of Hardhead, Shorty, and Fireside. Also, I'll have Sonja apologize to you.

say:31:1210426019:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，听我的！设计图要紧啊嚯！

say:33:1210426021:1.text: No objections? Great! Go help Lucca, hurry!
say:33:1210426021:1.source_cn: 那就说定了！你们赶紧出发吧！希望能追回来！

say:37:1210426013:1.text: Yes, this is different to what we agreed on. You said we just needed to enchant the cannon.
say:37:1210426013:1.source_cn: 这和说好的不一样，我们只帮你们附魔的！

say:40:1210426014:1.text: You can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.
say:40:1210426014:1.source_cn: 梅林可不是你们能随意使唤的！\n更别说你们之前还把我们...
say:40:1210426014:1.male: You can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.
say:40:1210426014:1.female: You can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.

say:42:1210426015:1.text: That's right, you can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.
say:42:1210426015:1.source_cn: 没错，梅林可不是你们能随意使唤的！\n更别说你们之前还...
say:42:1210426015:1.male: That's right, you can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.
say:42:1210426015:1.female: That's right, you can't just order Magister Merlin around! Not to mention, the Whispers treated us like prisoners before. We still have a score to settle.

choice:22:2:3.text: The Whispers treated me like a captive.
choice:22:2:3.source_cn: 血薇帮还把我当逃犯呢
choice:22:2:3.male: The Whispers treated me like a captive.
choice:22:2:3.female: The Whispers treated me like a captive.

say:0:1210440001:0.text: Keep calm! Don't let them provoke you!
say:0:1210440001:0.source_cn: 沉住气，不要搭理水鬼的挑衅！

say:2:1210443001:1.text: Lucca, these Wights are acting recklessly. Have we been tricked? The blueprints might not be with them.
say:2:1210443001:1.source_cn: 二当家，这帮水鬼有恃无恐，我们是不是中计了？设计图根本...

say:4:1210443003:1.text: Haha! They're not just gonna let us do that.
say:4:1210443003:1.source_cn: 开什么玩笑，水鬼怎么会乖乖让我们搜身？

say:5:1210443004:1.text: Then we'll beat them till they listen.
say:5:1210443004:1.source_cn: 那就，揍到他们乖乖听话为止。

say:3:1210445002:1.text: They must've split into two groups. One to lure us away and the other escaped with the blueprints.
say:3:1210445002:1.source_cn: 他们应该是分成了两路，一路诱敌，一路带设计图跑了。

say:5:1210445004:1.text: What do we do now? Do we keep chasing them?
say:5:1210445004:1.source_cn: 接下来怎么办，还要追吗？

say:6:1210445005:1.text: We'll have a few people continue forward and scout. The rest of you, follow me back to the workshop.
say:6:1210445005:1.source_cn: 留几个人继续往前探查，其他人，跟我回工坊！

say:3:1210446001:1.text: We didn't catch up with the Water Wights. They tricked us...
say:3:1210446001:1.source_cn: 没追上，那帮水鬼骗了我们……

say:5:1210446003:1.text: Don't blame Lucca. Who knew the Water Wights would split into two groups?
say:5:1210446003:1.source_cn: 也不能怪卢卡，谁知道水鬼在我们眼皮子底下还能兵分两路呢？

say:6:1210446004:0.text: Those Wights know the waters well. They must've drawn our attention at the docks when they jumped on their ship so the actual person with the blueprints could dive below the water.
say:6:1210446004:0.source_cn: 水鬼水性好，应该是在码头时用一艘船吸引了我们的注意力，...

say:10:1210446005:1.text: Don't blame yourself. You did what you could.
say:10:1210446005:1.source_cn: 你做的够好了，不要自责。

say:13:1210446006:1.text: We can't let it end like this, Sonja.

say:16:1210446007:1.text: Of course. We'll get to the bottom of this.

say:17:1210446008:1.text: How did the Water Wights get in? How did they know about our cannon project? They were able to raid our facility and steal our blueprints within a day. Either the enemy had infiltrated our facility already or there's a mole in the gang.
say:17:1210446008:1.source_cn: 水鬼是怎么潜入这里的？怎么知道我们在研究大炮的？今天他...

say:20:1210446009:1.text: Hm, I've been thinking about that. How did they know our location?
say:20:1210446009:1.source_cn: 我也想知道，他们是怎么摸到这的？要说没有人带路，我可不信！

say:24:1210446011:1.text: Hugin, how did the magister get here?
say:24:1210446011:1.source_cn: 呼金，这位魔法师大人是怎么到这里的？
say:24:1210446011:1.male: Hugin, how did the magister get here?
say:24:1210446011:1.female: Hugin, how did the magister get here?

say:25:1210446012:1.text: Do you think it's us again? We just helped you fight off the Water Wights!
say:25:1210446012:1.source_cn: 咦？你是在怀疑我们吗？我们刚才还帮你打走了水鬼呢！

say:26:1210446013:1.text: We Whispers hate betrayal. But don't worry, I know you've helped us. I just want to confirm how you got here from Darkstone Cave.
say:26:1210446013:1.source_cn: 血薇痛恨背叛。\n但别担心，无论怎样，你们刚才都帮了血...

choice_prompt:27:1210446013.text: We Whispers hate betrayal. But don't worry, I know you've helped us. I just want to confirm how you got here from Darkstone Cave.
choice_prompt:27:1210446013.source_cn: 血薇痛恨背叛。\n但别担心，无论怎样，你们刚才都帮了血薇帮。我只是确认一下，你们怎么从黑石洞到这里的。

say:30:1210446014:1.text: Yes, if we were with the Water Wights, we would've escaped during the chaos.
say:30:1210446014:1.source_cn: 对，如果我们是水鬼，刚才为什么不趁乱逃走？

say:33:1210446018:1.text: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?
say:33:1210446018:1.source_cn: 梅林是什么了不起的名号，为什么一次次提起？
say:33:1210446018:1.male: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?
say:33:1210446018:1.female: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?

say:36:1210446019:0.text: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!
say:36:1210446019:0.source_cn: ——了不起！当然了不起！非常了不起！太了不起了！
say:36:1210446019:0.male: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!
say:36:1210446019:0.female: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!

say:37:1210446020:1.text: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and he's alive!
say:37:1210446020:1.source_cn: 难怪你的魔法如此精妙！天呐，诸神在上，我居然见到了梅林...
say:37:1210446020:1.male: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and he's alive!
say:37:1210446020:1.female: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and she's alive!

say:39:1210446022:1.text: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. He once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...
say:39:1210446022:1.source_cn: 梅林，举世闻名的传奇魔法师！老师的《魔能宝典》里花了3...
say:39:1210446022:1.male: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. He once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...
say:39:1210446022:1.female: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. She once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...

say:42:1210446023:1.text: Alright, I got it. Get to the point.

say:43:1210446024:1.text: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.
say:43:1210446024:1.source_cn: 总之，水鬼帮绝对没法使唤梅林，我用铁头，火墙，矮地和老...
say:43:1210446024:1.male: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.
say:43:1210446024:1.female: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.

say:47:1210446026:1.text: If Hugin is swearing upon his master's reputation, is there any doubt?
say:47:1210446026:1.source_cn: 呼金都拿出老师的人格担保了，还有什么值得怀疑的吗？

say:48:1210446027:1.text: I'm not doubting him. I'm just thinking about how to apologize.
say:48:1210446027:1.source_cn: 不是怀疑。只是在想，该怎么道歉。

say:52:1210446029:1.text: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.
say:52:1210446029:1.source_cn: 我没见呼金这么崇拜他老师以外的第二个人。虽然我没听说过...
say:52:1210446029:1.male: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.
say:52:1210446029:1.female: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.

say:53:1210446030:1.text: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.
say:53:1210446030:1.source_cn: 你应该是很了不起的人物。抱歉，误会了。
say:53:1210446030:1.male: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.
say:53:1210446030:1.female: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.

say:54:1210446031:1.text: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.
say:54:1210446031:1.source_cn: 跟我们回锈锚港吧，让我们以血薇帮最高礼遇招待你。我们需...
say:54:1210446031:1.male: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.
say:54:1210446031:1.female: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.

say:58:1210446033:1.text: Will Sinbad go back with us?

say:61:1210446034:1.text: Of course, I don't want to face those Water Wights again. It's safer with you.
say:61:1210446034:1.source_cn: 当然，我害怕再遇到水鬼。荒郊野岭的，还是和你们一起更安全。

say:62:1210446035:1.text: Oh wait, I haven't officially introduced myself to the leaders of the Carmine Whispers yet.
say:62:1210446035:1.source_cn: 对了，还没向血薇帮的老大和二当家自我介绍呢。

say:63:1210446036:1.text: Hello, I'm Sinbad. I'm usually around the docks if you need a hired hand.
say:63:1210446036:1.source_cn: 你们好，我是辛巴达，在码头上混饭吃的。

say:64:1210446037:1.text: Hello, Sinbad. I heard of you from Lucca.
say:64:1210446037:1.source_cn: 你好，辛巴达。我听卢卡说过你。

say:69:1210446039:1.text: Sinbad told us he'd help us get out of Rustport, but he brought us to see Hugin, and then we met you again.
say:69:1210446039:1.source_cn: 多亏了狡猾的辛巴达，我们本来要离开锈锚港的，又被他带来...

say:70:1210446040:1.text: Ha... You know life isn't easy here. I'm just trying to make my way in the world.
say:70:1210446040:1.source_cn: 啊哈……生活不易，领个路，赚点吃饭钱而已。

say:74:1210446042:1.text: Let me make it clear that I'm not a Water Wight! My village is always getting robbed by those damn seadogs. If I was with them, they wouldn't have beaten me senseless earlier.
say:74:1210446042:1.source_cn: 声明一下，我可不是水鬼！你也知道，我们村子经常被水鬼帮...

say:75:1210446043:1.text: Alright... let's go back to Rustport first. We have many matters to deal with now that the Water Wights are on the attack.
say:75:1210446043:1.source_cn: 总之……先回锈锚港吧，水鬼帮来袭，我们还有更紧急的事要处理。

narration:76:1210446044:1.text: You all are welcomed as guests of honor of the Carmine Whispers in Rustport.

choice:32:0:1.text: I am Magister Merlin after all.
choice:32:0:1.male: I am Magister Merlin after all.
choice:32:0:1.female: I am Magister Merlin after all.

say:80:1210446015:0.text: Yes, if we were traitors, why didn't the Water Wights take us with them when they retreated?
say:80:1210446015:0.source_cn: 对，如果我们是内鬼，水鬼帮撤退为什么不带我们？

say:83:1210446016:1.text: If the magister wanted to take this place, he wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!
say:83:1210446016:1.source_cn: 主人如果要攻占这里，哪里还需要卧底，太小看我们了！
say:83:1210446016:1.male: If the magister wanted to take this place, he wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!
say:83:1210446016:1.female: If the magister wanted to take this place, she wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!

choice:27:2:3.text: I'm too powerful to be a spy.
choice:27:2:3.male: I'm too powerful to be a spy.
choice:27:2:3.female: I'm too powerful to be a spy.

say:3:1210402001:1.text: This shipyard is much larger than what Chippy imagined.
say:3:1210402001:1.source_cn: 这个造船厂比满满想象中大太多了。

say:4:1210402002:0.text: Sinbad, this shipyard seems to have no ships...
say:4:1210402002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，这个造船厂……好像没有船？

say:5:1210402003:1.text: Look at the cannon on the wall, it's so shiny. Are you sure this is a shipyard? It feels like a weapons workshop.
say:5:1210402003:1.source_cn: 瞧那城墙上的大炮，炮口锃亮锃亮的。你确定这是造船厂吗？...

say:6:1210402004:1.text: Whether it's a shipyard or a weapons workshop, they're all about making weapons. It doesn't really matter, does it? Would you not have come this way anyway?
say:6:1210402004:1.source_cn: 不管是造船厂，还是军工厂，总之都是武器厂，也没什么关系...

choice_prompt:7:1210402004.text: Whether it's a shipyard or a weapons workshop, they're all about making weapons. It doesn't really matter, does it? Would you not have come this way anyway?
choice_prompt:7:1210402004.source_cn: 不管是造船厂，还是军工厂，总之都是武器厂，也没什么关系吧？难道就因为是军工厂，你们就不走这条路了吗？

say:8:1210402005:1.text: I feel like Sinbad isn't being honest with us.
say:8:1210402005:1.source_cn: 总感觉……辛巴达没有对我们坦诚呢。

say:9:1210402006:0.text: Alright, I admit that I didn't tell you the truth, but it's because this place is a secret.
say:9:1210402006:0.source_cn: 好啦，别猜了。我承认，没有对你们说实话。因为这里是干什...

say:19:1210403001:0.text: Wow! Is that how powerful mages are? You actually blocked a cannonball!
say:19:1210403001:0.source_cn: 哇……这就是魔法师的力量吗？竟然能挡下炮弹？
say:19:1210403001:0.male: Wow! Is that how powerful mages are? You actually blocked a cannonball!
say:19:1210403001:0.female: Wow! Is that how powerful mages are? You actually blocked a cannonball!

say:22:1210403003:1.text: You urchins better get up here or you'll get shot again!
say:22:1210403003:1.source_cn: 你们几个娃子！我看见你们了！乖乖爬上来，不然就再吃一炮！

say:24:1210403005:0.text: What should we do? Should we listen to him?
say:24:1210403005:0.source_cn: 怎么办，我们要听他的话上去吗？

say:25:1210403006:1.text: No way! What if he's lying to us? We've been tricked before.
say:25:1210403006:1.source_cn: 不要！万一他是骗我们的……我们已经吃了几次亏了。

say:28:1210403008:1.text: Don't worry. That's Hugin. He won't hurt ya.
say:28:1210403008:1.source_cn: 别担心伙计们，呼金是我的老朋友了，他不会害你们的。

say:30:1210403010:0.text: Hugin's been looking for a mage. You'll see when you meet him.
say:30:1210403010:0.source_cn: 因为呼金等待魔法师已经太久，哈哈，你们上去就知道了。
say:30:1210403010:0.male: Hugin's been looking for a mage. You'll see when you meet him.
say:30:1210403010:0.female: Hugin's been looking for a mage. You'll see when you meet him.

narration:35:12010417:0.text: A cannonball plummets from above all of a sudden. Thanks to your quick reflexes, you block it with your magic shield.
narration:35:12010417:0.source_cn: 一颗炮弹突然从天而降。所幸你反应迅速，用魔法护盾挡下了它。

choice:27:0:1.text: Rustport is a tough place to live.
choice:27:0:1.male: Rustport is a tough place to live.
choice:27:0:1.female: Rustport is a tough place to live.
